name: Ekaterina Smirnova
source:
A snitch and a gossip. A teacher's pet and the daughter of Anton's homeroom teacher. Loves manipulating and pitting people against each other, feeding off the ensuing arguments. Behind her back, people call her a devil in the mask of an angel.

[From [url=https://bunny-horror.tumblr.com/en/]Tumblr[/url]]
